첫째.n: Ordinal noun for firstly when listing points, or the eldest child
cf: that day: a day already mentioned, usually past
Adverb meaning before others or ahead, as in going first
the number one in quality, like the best restaurant in town
written style, points back to a day just named
the day before a specific day, not simply yesterday
Modifier that must precede a noun, as in first time; cannot stand alone
the first day of something, such as a year or a trip
first year of a job or activity; plain, neutral
first ever, with no earlier case; news and records

잣대.n: figurative measure used to judge people or things
cf: the orthodox, proven way of doing something, also a go opening
Sino-Korean noun for a huge sum; formal, typical of news and finance.
Casual spoken noun for 'freebie'; informal, can sound slightly colloquial.
sizable sum of money in one chunk, whether saved, received or spent
money for personal spending, given or set aside regularly
coins or small bills, or the change received after paying
Native Korean compound for a big amount of money; casual and everyday.
